sources.finding: Moses distinguishes hand-held pen/pencil or planchette passive writing from claimed direct psychography. He reports a pocket-book, initially slow watched writing, later questions above answers, and subsequent revision. These attributed spiritualist accounts differ from rapid Surrealist composition; they do not establish spirit identity, external authorship or a general trance-induction protocol.
sources.rights_note: Commons marks US public domain; source-country and individual scan/reuse terms remain separate. Audit stores original facts only, not the scan/OCR corpus.1898 edition is not presumed identical to1883 or later editorial editions.

inventory_mapping_caution: All original rows and rankings preserved verbatim. Variation-source suggestions are not proof that Spirit Teachings defines stream-of-consciousness or ideomotor journaling. No substitution of ranked sources.
tradition_boundary: Voluntary human authorship, historically claimed passive/spirit writing, Surrealist procedure and literary stream-of-consciousness remain distinct. Generated prompts/text are software/model-authored and cannot certify spirits, unconscious origins, identity, predictions, diagnoses or hidden memories.

feasibility.first_scope: A separately named, voluntary source-guided writing-session workflow after exact Breton procedure/rights freeze. Preserve ordered raw segments and an explicit first draft, declared interruptions/restarts, optional end review and separately stored revisions. This adds procedural and revision structure beyond a relabeled Scrying journal.
session_features: Named procedure/version and voluntary prepared/writing/paused/stopped/review declarations; declaration is not proof of mental state or historical compliance
Ordered immutable raw segments with optional user-supplied timestamps; explicit pause/resume and restart events; no background key logging or inferred timing
Preserve original draft and separately linked revisions; never silently replace raw writing with edited or generated prose
Descriptive Unicode character/word counts, declared elapsed intervals and exact selected spans only after their conventions and known-answer fixtures are frozen
Separate user-attributed review/associations from source procedure and editorial questions; empty/unfinished sessions remain valid
feasibility.source_vs_software: Event states, replay hashes, timer options, metrics and review UI are proposed editorial software conventions, not claimed historical instructions. Chosen topic/random prompts would be a separately named creative adaptation, since the inspected Breton lead omits a preselected subject. No fixed historical duration invented.
feasibility.deterministic: Validation, ordering, declared-time arithmetic, metrics, provenance and JSON/Markdown replay can run locally without RNG or LLM. Do not score spontaneity, unconsciousness, trance, authorship or spirit authenticity from prose.
feasibility.generated_text: No generated text needed for first scope. Any future local generator must have separate opt-in mode, model/version/seed and input provenance; human and generated segments never merge silently. Generated output is creative composition, never spirit communication; a seed alone does not guarantee model replay.
feasibility.reuse: Only compatible pure text/timestamp/JSON/freeze/hash utilities from existing journals after a separate session schema is defined. Keep Dream/Mirror/Scrying engines, schemas, profiles and saved reports unchanged; do not import their historical interpretations.
feasibility.privacy: All personal content optional; local/offline default, no mandatory identity, health or belief data, no automatic sharing, cloud service, database, frontend or new framework.
